missions.title: SLEEVE
missions.summary: Mo needs a sleeve for the new Void Records twelve: a piece on a wall in the square, shot for the cover.
intro: mo. the new void twelve is pressed
need a sleeve. not a render. a real wall, shot at night
the square in the south block. big bare walls and nobody looks till morning

objectives.text: GET TO THE SQUARE IN THE SOUTH BLOCK
PUT A PIECE ON A WALL FACING THE SQUARE
hint: big wall. stand back and check the letters before you fill. B for the sketchbook
straight on. all of it in. no tilt

done: first copy is yours. and it's going in the window
